lead_raw_text:
This cubic structure of MgSnSb₂ (space group F-43m, No. 216) has a 16-atom unit cell with four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Sn each adopt tetrahedral environments with four Sb neighbors, while Sb centers have nine geometric neighbors (three Mg, three Sn, and three Sb). Corner-sharing between Mg- and Sn-centered tetrahedra is observed, alongside corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Sb-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
